rules.rationale: Extends baseline_balanced_v1 to qualified balance and demographic–anthropometric comparisons it misses, preserving the readers' PN. Anchors implement bounded sentence-level context exclusions, rather than matching an exact report sentence.
fires_on: Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups (Table 1 ).
Demographic and anthropometric characteristics of randomized patients were similar between the two treatment groups (Table 2 ).
Demographic and anthropometric characteristics of the randomised participants were comparable between the intervention groups.
must_not_fire_on: Baseline characteristics were not generally well balanced between the two groups.
In a previous trial, baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups.
Baseline characteristics were similar between the two groups.
Demographic and anthropometric characteristics of randomized patients were expected to be similar between the two treatment groups.
Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups, but allocation was manipulated.

rules.rationale: Extends baseline_balanced_v1 to comparisons placing baseline before the named groups. Requires an unqualified comparison covering demographic and clinical characteristics, preserving the readers' N.
fires_on: At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics
At baseline the intervention and control groups were comparable in terms of their demographic and clinical characteristics.
must_not_fire_on: At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were not similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics.
In another study, at baseline, the intervention and control groups were comparable in terms of their demographic and clinical characteristics.
At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic characteristics.
At follow-up, the intervention and control groups were comparable in terms of their demographic and clinical characteristics.

rules.rationale: Extends assessors_blinded_v1/v2 to named evaluating professionals followed by a relative clause. Requires an explicit assessment role and blinding to treatment allocation, supporting N; independence or participant blinding alone does not qualify.
fires_on: The patients’ MACE was evaluated by two independent cardiologists who were blinded to (unaware of) the treatment allocation.
All outcomes were assessed by three independent adjudicators who were unaware of treatment assignment.
All endpoints were evaluated by the committee members who were masked to the intervention allocation.
must_not_fire_on: The patients’ MACE was evaluated by two independent cardiologists who were not blinded to the treatment allocation.
In a previous trial, all outcomes were assessed by three independent adjudicators who were unaware of treatment assignment.
All endpoints were evaluated by the committee members who were masked to the participants' baseline risk.
Participants were unaware of treatment assignment.
There was no independent committee; all endpoints were evaluated by the committee members who were masked to the intervention allocation.
